posts.coverText: 4 things for late night talks

slideText.text: Do you think we met at the right time in life?
If you had to describe our connection in one word, what would it be?
What's one thing you'd change about how we handle conflict?
How do I make you feel special in ways no one else does?

posts.coverText: Hypothetical things to ask your man

slideText.text: You're blindfolded in a room with 20 other girls, and no one can speak. How would you know which one was me?
Be honest: if you could mute me for one hour every day, what time would you choose?
If I woke up tomorrow with no memory of us, would you try to make me fall in love with you again or would you let me go?
What version of me did you fall in love with that you don't see anymore?
What was it about me that made you stop looking?

posts.coverText: Only your boyfriend knows the answers to these questions

slideText.text: How do I act when I'm super happy?
What's your favorite weird habit of mine?
Why do you think I fell in love with you?

posts.coverText: Questions for bedtime talks

slideText.text: What assumption did you make about me that turned out to be false?
What's the most attractive thing I do without realizing it?
What was the first thing you noticed about me?

posts.coverText: 5 questions for late night conversations

slideText.text: What part of me do you still not fully understand?
What's one thing about me that feels a little too much like you?
What do you think I struggle with more than I admit?
What's something about me you admire but don't say enough?
What's one thing you think I'm still waiting for you to understand about me?

posts.coverText: Can your boyfriend answer these 4 questions?

slideText.text: What's the most "that's my girl" thing I've ever done?
When did you last look at me and think, "Damn, she's mine"?
What do I do that gives you butterflies even now?
What moment made you realize I was different from everyone else?

posts.coverText: 5 extra adorable questions to ask your boyfriend

slideText.text: What's something you never thought you'd enjoy doing until you did it with me?
What's a moment with me that you wish you could relive forever?
If you could take me anywhere in the world, where would it be, and why?
What's one thing you wish we did more often?
What do you want us to be doing together five years from now?

posts.coverText: Things to ask your gf

slideText.text: What do you really need from me when you're stressed?
What's something you've been afraid to ask me for?
What do I do that makes you feel like I really get you?
When do you feel the most loved by me?
What's one thing I could do more to make you feel appreciated?

posts.coverText: Things I wanna know but I'm afraid to ask

slideText.text: Who in your life didn't want us to date?
What's the most difficult thing about being with me?
Have you ever felt embarrassed by me in front of your friends?
What's one thing you miss about your single life?
What did you first tell your family about me?

posts.coverText: 5 extra sweet questions to ask your girlfriend

slideText.text: Which part of me is underrated?
What tiny thing do I do that shows I care?
When do you feel the safest with me?
What's a moment with me you replay in your head when you miss me?
Do I still give you butterflies? When?

posts.coverText: Awkward but healthy questions to ask him

slideText.text: How do you feel when I cry?
What do you find most difficult about me?
If I woke up tomorrow and didn't remember us, would you try again?
What's something you hold back from saying to protect me?
What's the one thing about me that made you stop looking for someone else?

posts.coverText: Brave questions to ask in your relationship

slideText.text: Would you say I'm the most attractive person you've dated?
What's the last thing you felt jealous about?
Is there something you're afraid to tell me because it might hurt?
Have you ever questioned if I was the right person for you?

posts.coverText: 4 silly questions to ask in your relationship

slideText.text: If you had to rename me based on my personality, what name would you choose?
What's one thing I do better than anyone you've ever dated?
Be honest: if I came with a warning label, what would it say?
What's something I swear I'm good at but am actually terrible at?

posts.coverText: Lowkey sneaky questions to ask your boyfriend

slideText.text: What's one insecurity of mine that you actually love?
Is there a time when you felt disconnected from me?
What's a detail about me that surprised you?
Is there a fear you have that you haven't shared with me?
What's something you wish I asked you more about?

posts.coverText: Extra cute questions to ask your boyfriend

slideText.text: If you could buy me one thing that you know would make me happy, what would it be?
What do I usually do when I'm nervous?
What's something I did recently that made you think, "I'm so lucky to have her"?
What am I bad at that you find secretly cute?

posts.coverText: Things I wanna know but don't dare ask

slideText.text: What's something you swore you'd never do, but now do for me?
What do you brag about the most when you talk about me?
What's a version of me you miss that I don't show?
If your friends told you to leave me, would you listen?
What's something small I do that makes you feel chosen?

posts.coverText: 5 either or questions for couples

slideText.text: Big wedding or big house?
Morning person or night person, and who has to change?
Call or text?
My family for the holidays or yours?
Dog or kid first?

posts.coverText: 5 ridiculously sweet questions to ask your love tonight

slideText.text: When did you first think about kissing me?
What's the best thing I've given you that wasn't a physical gift?
When did you realize I wasn't just someone you were dating?
What's something you're afraid I'll never understand about you?
Be honest: would you be proud to tell our kids how we met?

posts.coverText: Ask your partner these 3 cute questions

slideText.text: When we first met, did you think I was your type?
What's something you've always wanted from me but never asked for?
If we were alone right now and you could say anything, what would you say to me first?

posts.coverText: 5 ridiculously silly questions to ask your man tonight

slideText.text: What's something about you that only I seem to handle well?
What's the most "me" moment you've ever seen?
What's the dumbest thing I've ever said with full confidence?
If you could steal one thing from me forever, what would it be?
